About the job

Syntrace builds conversational knowledge for institutional investors. We capture, organize and synthesize private conversations into source-backed knowledge a firm can build on.




We are now hiring a Software Engineer, based in Mumbai.




You will build across the stack in a small senior team where you own features end to end. Our core is event-sourced and real-time by design, and you will help shape how it grows.




Our users trust us with the most sensitive conversations they have. That makes security part of the product, not a feature on top of it.




What you bring:




- A few years building production software, or exceptional work that speaks for itself.

- Strong TypeScript or Python.

- Care for detail.




What you get:




- A founding role with real ownership.

- A senior team that has scaled companies before.

- A modern stack, built properly from day one.




To apply, send a short note to careers@syntrace.com about yourself.




If you know someone who should read this, send it to them.
